origin.description: A forge origin: https, or http for a LAN or tailnet instance, then the host in lower case and a port only when it is not the scheme's default (https://git.example.com:5526); no userinfo, path or trailing slash.

kind.description: The kind of forge the origin is: github, forgejo or gitea.

version.description: The version the forge answered (16.0.3+gitea-1.22.0, 3.19.0); null where it gives none: github.com, and a Forgejo or Gitea that asks every caller to sign in.

url.description: The page on the forge where the token is minted, with any prefill in its query.

prefilled.description: Whether the link fills in what to grant, so the person only confirms it; false for a page where they tick it themselves.

repositoryAccess.description: Repository access to choose: All repositories, which creating one needs.

name.description: The permission as the token page names it: Contents, Issues, Pull requests, Administration.

access.description: The access it needs: read, or write (Read and write on the page), which includes read.

items.description: One permission a fine-grained token is granted, and its access.

oneOf.description: GitHub's fine-grained personal access token: its repository access and the permissions it is granted.

url.description: The page on the forge where the token is minted, with any prefill in its query.

prefilled.description: Whether the link fills in what to grant, so the person only confirms it; false for a page where they tick it themselves.

scopes.description: The scopes to tick: repo and read:org.

oneOf.description: GitHub's classic personal access token and the scopes it is granted.

url.description: The page on the forge where the token is minted, with any prefill in its query.

prefilled.description: Whether the link fills in what to grant, so the person only confirms it; false for a page where they tick it themselves.

scopes.description: The scopes to give it, as the API names them (write:repository); on the page, each category at Read or Read and write.

oneOf.description: A Forgejo or Gitea access token, minted on the user's Applications settings, and the scopes it is given.

items.description: A page where a person mints the token a forge account needs, whether the link fills it in, and what the token must be granted.

tokenPages.description: Where to mint the token and what to grant it, the page to offer first at the head.
